analyst_reports.business_description: Online used-car retailer: e-commerce purchase, financing attach, home delivery, and vertically integrated reconditioning. The entry thesis (~6 quarters ago): the category winner digitizing the largest US retail category still transacted offline, with a SCALE-ECONOMICS INFLECTION to profitability imminent — gross profit per unit rising while per-unit SG&A falls with density, so growth mechanically converges on EBITDA breakeven. Milestones: (a) GPU continuing to climb, (b) per-unit SG&A leverage each quarter, (c) EBITDA breakeven within a couple of years, funded without distressed capital. Falsifiers recorded at entry: unit economics failing to inflect (GPU falling or SG&A per unit rising), leverage becoming a SURVIVAL question rather than a growth tool, and the used-car cycle reversing against an inventory-owning model.
recent_developments: The unit-economics falsifier fired: gross profit per unit fell -23% YoY while unit growth collapsed to +14% (units down sequentially) and the quarterly loss set a company record — the inflection is moving AWAY, not closer, at larger scale.

The leverage falsifier fired: the company closed a levered ~2530 acquisition of a national physical auction network, financed with 3765 of unsecured 8-year notes at a 10.25% coupon (a large credit fund anchored half); pro-forma debt is ~7600 against negative EBITDA, and a business-press column framed the financing itself as a rescue. The notes already trade below issue price.

The cycle falsifier is firing: wholesale used-vehicle values peaked around the turn of the year at shock-era records and are now declining month after month, while rate spikes crush monthly-payment affordability — a direct mark-to-market risk for an inventory-owning retailer.

Emergency posture is visible: ~12% of the workforce cut ~5 weeks ago with executives forgoing salaries to fund severance, and a heavily dilutive equity raise priced ~-70% below the prior-year high, with insiders buying a large chunk of it.

The solvency debate is live in the press and sell-side notes: bears argue the company is up against the clock on cash at the current burn; bulls counter that liquidity fears are overblown, the raise plus collateral capacity buys several quarters, and the secular-shift thesis is intact at ~0.3x sales.

The bull case is not a strawman: ~16,000 annualized revenue scale, a founder-led team with high insider ownership that just bought more stock, a genuinely differentiated logistics/reconditioning network the auction acquisition deepens, the online-shift secular story still real — and after -91%, a lot of the bear case is arguably in the price.
analyst_reports.macro_context: The fastest rate-tightening cycle in decades; auto-loan affordability at record lows; the high-yield market has effectively closed to stressed issuers, so refinancing optionality is gone; consumer discretionary demand rolling over from the shock-era spike.
